title: Pleasant Experience
content:
I ordered my husbands prescription twice by phone through the chemist. Each time I went to pick it up, it had not been ordered.
I called the doctors and explained the situation to the lady on the phone who rushed his prescription through the same day. Thank you, it was much appreciated.
We are moving out of the area soon, so will unfortunately have to move doctors. But I would definitely recommend this surgery.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
